unlisted_practices: Ensure equity is at the forefront of every AI tool's development, deployment, and monitoring to avoid reinforcing disparities.
Ensure equitable access to AI-enabled dental technologies, especially for underrepresented populations.
Academic dental institutions should evaluate the safety and efficacy of competing AI technologies.
Dental schools should form academic-industry partnerships with AI tools to engage patients, practitioners, and third-party payers.
Offer continuing education and collaboration with industry AI developers to practicing dentists, hygienists, and dental faculty.
Government agencies should develop guidelines for ethical, transparent, and fair AI use in oral health.
Funders should support AI-focused funding mechanisms for capacity-building and scalability in dentistry.
Academic institutions should invest in data management and computing infrastructure for AI.

screen.reason: This is a viewpoint commentary exploring how AI can be leveraged in dentistry to address oral health disparities and health equity.
